bridgeRouteRisk.summary: nOPAL has four reviewed independent native-issuance routes on Ethereum, Plume, BSC, and Plasma, plus reviewed LayerZero OFT representations on Solana, World Chain, and Avalanche. The issuer registry and explorer records identify the exact deployments. Structured controls record the Solana OFT mint-authority/program-admin path and World Chain/Avalanche bridge-mint, peer-configuration, and upgrade paths. Complete LayerZero DVN configuration, controller key custody, route limits, and recovery remain undisclosed. Arc ownership and selected current role/authorization paths are pinned, including direct enter/exit/manage alternatives to the owner timelock; Arc issuance-versus-representation accounting, full authority closure and incident state remain unresolved.
